remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing-Darien's premier new construction luxury apartment community offering modern living with unbeatable convenience. Situated directly across from the Metro North train station, Heights Crossing offers seamless access to NYC while being rooted in a vibrant, coastal New England town.  This stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment features a thoughtfully designed open layout with a welcoming foyer, wood-style luxury vinyl tile flooring throughout, and a bright living area. The adjacent full bathroom includes a sleek stall shower and is conveniently located near the spacious bedroom. The kitchen blends function and elegance with Quartz countertops, a large island, GE appliances, custom cabinetry, and a striking backsplash. Additional highlights include a stacked in-unit washer and dryer and walk-in-closet for added storage. Designed for comfort and privacy, the building includes soundproofing between floors and exterior foam insulation. Residents will enjoy access to a beautifully landscaped fountain courtyard and ground-level retail. Located just moments from the Noroton Heights shopping district, grocery store, and pharmacy-with Darien's beaches and Great Island just a short drive away.
